channelWeight.trainingBoundary: Filename mentioning 35 videos does not establish training data or test leakage.

findings.finding: Attention is a per-pixel Linear 16→8→4→8→16 encoder/decoder with ReLU after first encoder/decoder layers, global res2/max(res2), spectral Softmax and spatial mean to rank bands; reduction argument unused. Fixed 16 input channels in default loader.

For 16 sorted bands (zero-based ranks): (0,9,10),(1,8,11),(2,7,12),(3,6,13),(4,5,14),(0,8,15). All 16 covered with ranks0/8 reused, not top-three selection. Group weights sum selected band weights then normalize. This rank heuristic alone does not guarantee equal group totals.

Each frame reloads the attention model and recomputes rank; input FCI uses original normalized cube, ignores attention feature output. Template kernels fixed from first-frame groups; changing rank can change group channel identity. No actual rank traces were obtained to show its empirical effect.

Global YCrCb luminance histogram equalization active in template and main search paths, local CLAHE commented. SiamRPN five Conv stages with BN, kernel classification/regression cross-correlation. Weighted penalized/Hann classification responses choose common anchor; regression offsets averaged equally across groups, not group-weighted.

Defaults template127/search271 (287 if target area<.007), stride8, ratios .33/.5/1/2/3 and scale8, penalty .055/Hann .42/lr .295. Scale tune uses fixed group0 rather than commented argmax group, features/correlation with three scales .98/1/1.02, scale_lr .59 and penalty .9745. Scale search does not call the active global equalizer, while template feature came from equalized image.

init and update are the used interface. Unused SiamRPN.forward calls **self.learn(z), although learn returns tuple; do not treat this unused entry as proof the actual tracking path failed. No gradient training or epoch pipeline in the nine inspected Python files; internal README inherited upstream training-data statements cannot prove this paper training protocol.

Default Windows E:/data/whisper/, test/HSI, external SiamRPN weight, visualization on. Dataset reads modality-specific groundtruth_rect.txt, HSI png, others jpg; experiment enumerates folders with check_integrity=False, not authoritative list.txt or a reproducible benchmark release.

OPE initial GT only to tracker; report excludes first-frame boxes, AO=mean IoU and SR=IoU>.5, 101-point strict IoU>threshold success curve. Plot legend labels AO, not mean-curve AUC; no precision/DP report. report bound inferred once then reused across sequences and rect_iou clips arrays in place; actual call/bounds impact unverified without images/GT.

Timer starts after image read, cube reconstruction, attention model loading/inference, grouping and PIL conversion; visualization also excluded. _evaluate uses mean(1/time), not 1/mean(time). _record appends timing columns if previous time file exists; one current prediction file and two timing columns do not prove two corresponding prediction runs.

runtimeBoundary: Nine source files fully inspected; only original NumPy utility function ASTs run on synthetic inputs. No torch.load, full model, CUDA, real videos, GT or training run.
